valid_range.name: valid_range
valid_range.value: "contracts"."valid_to" is null or "contracts"."valid_from" is null or "contracts"."valid_to" >= "contracts"."valid_from"

qty_with_unit.name: qty_with_unit
qty_with_unit.value: ("trips"."loaded_qty" is null) = ("trips"."loaded_unit" is null) and ("trips"."discharged_qty" is null) = ("trips"."discharged_unit" is null)

discharge_after_loading.name: discharge_after_loading
discharge_after_loading.value: "trips"."discharge_date" is null or "trips"."loading_date" is null or "trips"."discharge_date" >= "trips"."loading_date"
